spec.description: Backup health, freshness and storage for Duplicati, exported by duplicati-exporter.

spec.title: Avg. duration
spec.description: Average duration of the last completed run.

spec.title: Total uploaded
spec.description: Bytes uploaded by the last run of each backup. Requires the Duplicati webhook.

spec.title: Oldest last backup
spec.description: Age of the least recently completed backup.

spec.title: Machines up
spec.description: Machines whose Duplicati API is reachable.

spec.title: Backup state
spec.description: Green: OK. Yellow: warning (missed schedule, or warning result via webhook). Red: failed (active error notification, or fatal result via webhook).

spec.expr: (clamp_max(2 * duplicati_backup_failure{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} + (duplicati_backup_last_result{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} == 2 or duplicati_backup_failure{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} * 0), 2) > 0) or (clamp_max(duplicati_backup_stale{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} + (duplicati_backup_last_result{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} == 1 or duplicati_backup_stale{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} * 0), 1) unless (clamp_max(2 * duplicati_backup_failure{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} + (duplicati_backup_last_result{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} == 2 or duplicati_backup_failure{machine_name=~"$machine", backup_name=~"$backup"} * 0), 2) > 0))

spec.title: Last finished
spec.description: When the last completed run of each backup finished.

spec.title: Next run
spec.description: When each backup is scheduled to run next.

spec.title: Time since last completed backup
spec.description: Age of the last completed run. Compare with the backup schedule.

spec.title: Time since newest remote fileset
spec.description: Advances only after a successful upload.

spec.title: Uploaded size
spec.description: Bytes uploaded by the last run. Requires the Duplicati webhook.

spec.title: Free backend quota
spec.description: Only shown for backends that report a quota.

spec.title: Stale backups
spec.description: Scheduled run has passed without a finished or successful backup.

spec.title: Failing backups
spec.description: Backups with an active error notification.

spec.title: Duplicati
